knight.classPerkEffect: Once per turn, after using Armour Restoration or Fortify, gain Minor Guard Up (+4 Guard) until the start of your next turn.
knight.classPerkTrigger: Once per turn after Armour Restoration or Fortify.
knight.notes: Defensive class hook. Does not create Armour by itself.

rogue.classPerkEffect: Once per turn, if acting before the target, your first Weapon Skill 1 gains +10 Precision. If that skill breaks Armour, gain Minor Agility Up (+4 Agility) until the start of your next turn.
rogue.classPerkTrigger: Once per turn; applies to a 2 EN Weapon Skill 1.
rogue.hook: Weapon Skill 1; Armour break; turn order
rogue.notes: Replaces the legacy first 1 EN damage bonus.

mage.classPerkEffect: The first Magic weapon skill you use each turn deals 10% additional damage to Magic Armour only. This bonus does not increase Health damage.
mage.classPerkTrigger: Once per turn on the first Magic weapon skill.
mage.notes: Encourages breaking Magic Armour without inflating Health damage.

siren.classPerkEffect: Once per turn after you break Magic Armour, the next ailment or stat debuff you apply to that target gains +10 percentage points application chance and lasts 1 additional turn.
siren.classPerkTrigger: Once per turn; consumed by the next qualifying ailment or debuff.
siren.notes: Does not bypass Magic Armour or guarantee application.

inquisitor.classPerkEffect: Once per turn after a damaging skill hits an ailmented, debuffed or Marked target, restore 2 to the lower of Armour or Magic Armour, capped at its normal maximum. If both pools are full, heal 5% Maximum Health.
inquisitor.classPerkTrigger: Once per turn after Health damage to a qualifying target.
inquisitor.notes: Carrion Mark and other non-stat Marks may qualify when explicitly stated.

bard.classPerkEffect: Once per turn, when you alternate Martial and Magic damaging skills, the second skill restores 2 to the lower protection pool. If both pools are full, it gains +10 Skill Power instead.
bard.classPerkTrigger: Once per turn on the second skill in a Martial/Magic alternation.
bard.hook: Hybrid weapons; protection restoration; Skill Power
bard.notes: The second skill must be a damaging skill.

brute.classPerkEffect: Once per turn after Armour absorbs physical damage, your next Strength weapon skill gains +10 Skill Power.
brute.classPerkTrigger: Once per turn; consumed on the next Strength weapon skill.

duke.classPerkEffect: After defeating an enemy, restore 25% of normal Maximum Armour and Magic Armour and gain +5% all damage for the remainder of combat.
duke.classPerkTrigger: After each enemy defeated in sequential combat.
duke.notes: Boss Duke override remains separate: while above 50% Health, +10% damage and 10% less damage taken.
